foods.name: Amber Harvest Flatbread
foods.description: Warm barley flatbread from Garr's morning kiln, still soft at the edges.
foods.passive: After you finish a Short Rest where you ate this flatbread, you gain 1d4 temporary hit points.

foods.name: Sun-Kissed Dried Apricots
foods.description: River-valley apricots dried on wicker racks until honey-sweet.
foods.passive: Within the next hour, you have advantage on your next Wisdom (Perception) check.

foods.name: River-Town Pickled Herring
foods.description: Brined herring packed in oak barrels for dockhands and carters.
foods.passive: Within the next 8 hours, you gain a +2 bonus to your next Constitution saving throw against poison.

foods.name: Smoked Barley Porridge
foods.description: Slow-smoked grain porridge sold by the ladle to cold morning crews.
foods.passive: If you eat this during breakfast, you can reduce your exhaustion level by 1 (no effect if you have 0 exhaustion). You can benefit once per long rest.

foods.name: Honey Oat Bites
foods.description: Chewy oat clusters bound with local honey from Moll's hives.
foods.passive: For 1 minute after eating, your walking speed increases by 10 feet.

foods.name: Caravan Spice Nuts
foods.description: Roasted nuts tossed in pepper, cumin, and road-salt for long hauls.
foods.passive: For 1 hour after eating, you have resistance to cold damage.

foods.name: Garr's Trail Crunch
foods.description: A dense mix of grain, nuts, and dried fruit measured for a full day's march.
foods.passive: You do not need to consume additional food or water for the next 24 hours.

foods.name: Golden Millet Cakes
foods.description: Small millet cakes stamped with the Hopsack yard mark.
foods.passive: Within the next hour, you gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma (Persuasion) check.

foods.name: Fermented Cabbage Kraut
foods.description: Sharp kraut fermented in stone crocks behind the grain yard.
foods.passive: Within the next 24 hours, you have advantage on your next saving throw against disease.

foods.name: Harvest Moon Stew
foods.description: A sealed jar of root-vegetable stew slow-cooked after the autumn moon.
foods.passive: When you consume this stew during a Short Rest, you regain 1d4 + 1 hit points.
